title: Wet Hot American Summer
tagline: Last day of camp. First night of snacks.
about: The counsellors at a 1981 summer camp try to sort out their love lives on the last day before everyone goes home.

    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersGene's mixed vegetable frittersSpiced chickpea flour fritters with corn, peas and carrot, lime yoghurtHow to make it150g besan (chickpea flour)ground cumin, to tastechilli powder, to taste150g frozen corn kernels100g frozen peas1 carrot3 spring onions1 L vegetable oil200g Greek yoghurt1 lime1 bunch coriander180ml water1 tsp saltMix the besan (chickpea flour), the cumin, a little chilli powder, the salt and some the water into a thick batter.Stir in the corn kernels, the peas, the grated carrot and the sliced spring onions.Heat 3cm oil to 180°C and fry heaped tablespoons for 3 minutes, turning, until crisp.Drain.Mix the Greek yoghurt with lime juice and chopped coriander for dipping.Camp Firewood mess hall corn dogsGene runs the mess hall, and he has a few things he needs to sayHow to make it8 frankfurts150g fine polenta150g self-raising flour2 tbsp caster sugar1 tsp salt1 egg250ml full cream milk8 bamboo skewers2 L vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp yellow mustard4 tbsp tomato sauceWhisk the polenta, flour, sugar and salt with the egg and milk into a thick batter, then pour into a tall glass.Heat the oil to 180°C. Pat the frankfurts dry, push in the skewers and dust with a little flour.Dip each frankfurt in the batter and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden.Drain and serve with the mustard and tomato sauce.MainsMess hall sloppy joe slidersSaucy beef mince with cheddar and pickles on slider bunsHow to make it500g beef mince1 brown onion1 green capsicum2 garlic cloves200ml tomato sauceWorcestershire sauce, to taste1 tbsp brown sugarmustard, to taste12 slider buns6 slices of cheddar1 jar dill pickles100ml waterBrown the beef mince with the diced onion and the diced green capsicum for 8 minutes.Add the garlic cloves, the tomato sauce, the Worcestershire, the brown sugar, the mustard and the water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.Toast the slider buns, add a slice of cheddar to each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced pickles.Andy's Camp Tigerclaw game day fried chickenFuel for the softball game against Camp TigerclawHow to make it800g chicken tenderloins300ml buttermilk150g plain flour2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder500ml vegetable oil, for frying300g shredded cabbage3 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 tbsp apple cider vinegar8 dill pickle slicesSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt.Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt and toss the chicken through it.Shallow fry in batches in hot oil until golden and cooked through.Toss the cabbage with the mayonnaise and vinegar and serve with the chicken and pickles.SweetsLast day bug juice ice blocksFrozen watermelon, strawberry, orange and lime pops sweetened with honeyHow to make it300g watermelon200g strawberries2 oranges1 lime2 tbsp honey8 ice blocks of moulds and sticksBlend the watermelon, the strawberries, the juice of the oranges, the juice of the lime and the honey until smooth.Dice a few extra strawberries and drop them into ice block moulds.Pour in the punch, add sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.Run the moulds under warm water for a few seconds to release.Camp Firewood salted caramel s'moresToasted marshmallow, milk chocolate and salted caramel between biscuitsHow to make it100g sugar80ml thickened cream20g butter16 wheatmeal biscuits100g milk chocolate16 large marshmallowsMake the caramel: melt the sugar until amber, whisk in the cream and the butter, then a little salt and cool.Lay the digestive or wheatmeal biscuits on a board and top them with a square of milk chocolate.Toast the large marshmallows on skewers over a fire or gas flame until golden.Push the onto each chocolate biscuit, spoon over caramel and squash with a second biscuit.DrinksCamp Firewood bug juice punchCranberry, pineapple and orange juice with raspberry cordial, chilledHow to make it400ml cranberry juice300ml pineapple juice3 oranges60ml raspberry cordial600ml lemonade100g frozen mixed berries4 cups iceIn a large jug, mix the cranberry juice, the pineapple juice, the juice of the oranges and the raspberry cordial.Chill 1 hour.Just before serving, add plenty of ice, the cold lemonade, a sliced orange and a handful of frozen berries.Stir once and ladle into plastic cups.
